title: Family members and music; grandmother as weather prophet
summary: Her father was a cigar maker and no family members were musicians; her grandmother is recalled predicting weather and instructing the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were any of your family musicians, that is your grandfather or father, did they play anything or sing music?

Oh, nothing I know of. No, my father was a cigar maker. Cigar maker. Mm-hmm. And my grandfather, I never knew him. Yeah. But I remember my grandmother good. Just like I was looking at you. Oh, I wish she was here.
What did she sing, your grandmother?
Did she sing around the house like you do? Any little songs?
Oh, sometimes she'd sing, but I don't remember it.

She was too busy. She had so many grandchildren, you know. Yes. And she took such interest in her children. Oh, she took interest in explaining you things and showing you things and telling you about the weather. When it was going to, the weather was going to change, she was just like a good astronomer. She could tell you. You know, we all washed, my parents, my mother and aunts and them, and she'd come and look up, and she'd say, you all can make your starch today. But, the moment, but look at the weather. Make your starch. Then she'd look up. She'd say, by six hour, we'll have an embelli. Embelli means, you know, the weather changing.
